svg.title: Hypoxia Gradient — Spheroid section
svg.desc: Qualitative oxygen availability decreases with distance from a vessel or toward a spheroid core. Dots indicate relative oxygen availability only. Hypoxia severity, consumption, length scale and concentration are not measured; real gradients depend on perfusion, diffusion and cellular demand.
